A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 35-page GFM-RAG paper, including Appendices A–G and the checklist. Complete text and rendered-page comparisons identify differences only in the first-page arXiv stamp and Table 6.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E report original retrieval, question-answering, efficiency, ablation, transferability, scaling and knowledge-graph-completion results.

after.justification: v3 retains the original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix E, including benchmark comparisons and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: The KG-index construction, query-dependent GNN, two-stage training, document ranking and answer-generation procedures are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same multi-hop QA, domain-specific retrieval and KG-completion coverage. Table 6 revises size statistics for existing datasets without adding or removing a dataset, task or test scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in every reported comparison, including the main benchmark tables and Appendix E experiments.

E3.justification: Table 6 changes the reported test-corpus size from 6,119 to 11,656 documents for MuSiQue and from 11,656 to 6,119 for 2Wiki. Both retain 1,000 test questions. This revises stated experimental settings without establishing that experiments were rerun; other protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations, transferability tests, scaling analyses, reasoning-path cases, hop-distribution analysis and KG-quality comparisons are unchanged.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 retains the same fixed-random-seed statement. Statistical reporting and plotted uncertainty displays are unchanged, with no additional runs, confidence intervals or significance tests documented.

E6.justification: Table 6 reassigns the reported KG-construction statistics: MuSiQue changes from 48,779 entities, 20,748 relations and 160,950 triples to 100,853 entities, 55,944 relations and 319,618 triples; 2Wiki changes in the reverse direction. All performance scores, efficiency measurements and other empirical findings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(21) and Appendix A's treatment of query-dependent GNN reasoning are identical. No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about novelty, single-step multi-hop reasoning, generalizability, efficiency and scaling.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the experiments and the limitations in Appendix G are unchanged. Neither version explains the Table 6 reassignment or draws a new conclusion from it.

D1.justification: Table 6 revises the dataset-specific corpus and KG-size information available for reproducing or checking the test indexes. Implementation settings, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, prompts and access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, citations and bibliography are identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 20 October 2025 to v3 dated 11 December 2025. The prose, terminology, section order and appendix structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, table structures, captions, placement and page layout are unchanged. Table 6 changes numerical contents only; the arXiv stamp changes text without altering the layout.

improvement.justification: The only substantive edit swaps the MuSiQue and 2Wiki corpus/KG statistics in Table 6. Neither PDF explains the swap or independently establishes which assignment is correct, so it could fix or introduce a reporting error. With methods, performance evidence and exposition otherwise unchanged, the net effect on quality cannot be reliably determined.
